Flow control

Match is an if; Switch picks the first matching case.

<Switch on={query.status} exhaustive>
  <$Case is="pending"><Spinner /></$Case>
  <$Case is="success"><List /></$Case>
</Switch>

Keyboard shortcuts

Esc
Close a dialog or a menu
Tab
Move through a menu
